texts.orig: Good Gradings of Generalized Incidence Rings
texts.text: Good Gradings of Generalized Incidence Rings

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This inquiry is based on both the construction of generalized incidence due to Gene Abrams and the construction of group gradings of incidence algebras due to Molli Jones. We provide conditions for a generalized incidence ring to be graded isomorphic to a subring of an incidence ring over preorder . We also extend Jones's construction to group gradings for incidence algebras over preorders with crosscuts of length one Or rings good good two.
